content.thinking:
Both servers connect via jump hosts (connect.westb.seetacloud.com and connect.westd.seetacloud.com) with specific ports. These are AutoDL instances that use SSH tunneling through their gateway servers, so direct SCP between them isn't possible - they can't reach each other directly.

The solution is to relay through the local machine. I can use scp with a local intermediate, or use ssh tunneling to proxy the connection.

Option 1: Download from westd to local, then upload from local to westb. This would be slow and require 12GB local storage.


Option 2: Use scp -3, which routes the transfer through my local machine as a relay point instead of trying to connect the two servers directly.

Actually, I should run this in the background or with nohup since 12GB could take a while and might timeout otherwise.
